In the figure, direction c points along the radius toward the center of the circle, and direction a is perpendicular to direction c. When the turntable rotates counterclockwise, which of the following statements is correct (　　)
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text: When the turntable rotates uniformly, the direction of the friction force on P is c

When the turntable rotates counterclockwise uniformly, which direction is the direction of the friction force on P?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: In the image, the horizontal turntable is drawn as a circle, the center O of the circle is on the left side, and block P is located to the right of the center O; from O to near P there is a horizontal dashed line indicating the radial direction. Among the candidate directions, the c arrow points horizontally leftward from near P along the dashed line, that is, points along the radius toward the center O; the a arrow points vertically upward and is perpendicular to direction c; b is the upper-left direction, and d is the lower-left direction. The curved arrow labeled ω on the right indicates that the turntable rotates counterclockwise. The problem statement states that block P makes counterclockwise uniform rotation together with the turntable, so P undergoes uniform circular motion. Uniform circular motion has no tangential acceleration and only requires centripetal acceleration directed toward the center of the circle. The block is on a horizontal turntable; gravity and the supporting force are balanced in the vertical direction, and the only force that can provide centripetal force in the horizontal direction is static friction. Therefore, the friction force on P must point toward the center of the circle, namely direction c in the figure.
